_README: TEMPLATE ONLY -- every number below is synthetic filler, not WISC-V norms.
No normative data ships with this repository. If you are licensed to use the
official WISC-V norms, transcribe them into this shape and load the file with
'Load norms' in the app. The file is read in your browser only; it is never
uploaded, and it is not written back to this repository.
A lookup table is an array of {max, score} rungs, ordered by ascending max.
The first rung whose 'max' is >= the input wins, so published tables that
collapse a band of raw scores onto one scaled score transcribe directly:
[{max: 5, score: 1}, {max: 12, score: 7}]  =>  raw 0-5 scores 1, raw 6-12 scores 7.
'ageBands' drives raw-score-to-scaled-score conversion and is keyed by age in
whole months. 'compositeTables' overrides the model's estimated
sum-of-scaled-scores-to-composite conversion. Either section may be omitted.
label: Synthetic template (not real norms)
